mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG (LOG_ID, OCCURRED_AT, ACTOR_ID, ACTION, TARGET, DETAIL, CLIENT_IP, PREV_HASH, ROW_HASH) VALUES (#{logId}, #{occurredAt}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{target}, #{detail}, #{clientIp}, #{prevHash}, #{rowHash})
mapper.select: SELECT LAST_LOG_ID AS "lastLogId", LAST_HASH AS "lastHash" FROM AUDIT_CHAIN WHERE CHAIN_ID = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE AUDIT_CHAIN SET LAST_LOG_ID = #{logId}, LAST_HASH = #{hash} WHERE CHAIN_ID = 1
mapper.select: SELECT LAST_LOG_ID AS "lastLogId", LAST_HASH AS "lastHash" FROM AUDIT_CHAIN WHERE CHAIN_ID = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE ROW_HASH IS NULL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT LOG_ID, OCCURRED_AT, ACTOR_ID, ACTION, TARGET, DETAIL, CLIENT_IP FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE OCCURRED_AT >= #{from} AND OCCURRED_AT < #{to} AND ACTION IN ('FILE_DOWNLOAD', 'CIVIL_VIEW', 'WELFARE_VIEW', 'LOGIN_FAIL', 'RECORD_TRANSFER_LIST') ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20000
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUDIT_REVIEW (REVIEW_ID, PERIOD_FROM, PERIOD_TO, RESULT, CHAIN_OK_YN, NOTE, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_NAME, REVIEWED_AT) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{periodFrom}, #{periodTo}, #{result}, #{chainOkYn}, #{note}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedName}, #{reviewedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT REVIEW_ID, PERIOD_FROM, PERIOD_TO, RESULT, CHAIN_OK_YN, NOTE, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_NAME, REVIEWED_AT FROM AUDIT_REVIEW ORDER BY REVIEWED_AT DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 24
